title: It's Not Easy Being Me — EN/DE/ZH (Chas McIvor)
style: jazz lounge piano bar dry wit spoken word cabaret 106bpm upright bass brushed snare deadpan baritone male vocal English German Chinese language learning trilingual
lyrics:
[Verse 1 — English]
People think it's easy being me
Standing at the front of every family scene
Dad on the phone, Dad on the group, Dad getting tagged
It's not easy being me — and nobody asked

[Verse 2 — Deutsch]
Die Leute denken, es ist einfach, ich zu sein [People think it's easy being me]
Im Vordergrund jeder Familienszene zu stehen [Standing at the front of every family scene]
Papa am Telefon, Papa in der Gruppe, Papa wird getaggt [Dad on the phone, Dad in the group, Dad being tagged]
Es ist nicht einfach, ich zu sein — und niemand fragte [It's not easy being me — and nobody asked]

[Chorus — English]
It's not easy being me
The jazz is in my blood and the words come free
Three sons and a garden and Wilma by my side
It's not easy being me — but I wouldn't change the ride

[Bridge — 中文]
人们以为做我很容易 [People think it's easy being me]
站在每一个家庭场景的前面 [Standing at the front of every family scene]
爸爸在电话里，爸爸在群里，爸爸被@ [Dad on the phone, Dad in the group, Dad being tagged]
做我并不容易 — 但我不会改变这段旅程 [It's not easy being me — but I wouldn't change this ride]

[Verse 3 — English]
Pete's up on his charter, Joel's in hospital, Corey's on the beach
Wilma's in the garden and somehow I'm in reach

[Outro — EN/DE/ZH]
It's not easy being me
Es ist nicht einfach, ich zu sein [It's not easy being me]
做我并不容易 [It's not easy being me]
That's my boy
